blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A University of the Philippines (UP) Diliman committee condemned the alleged violent dispersal by the Philippine National Police (PNP) of a rally decrying Pax Silica. “We hold the Philippine government and the PNP to account for this blatant violation of the right to free assembly and speech,” the UP Diliman committee on the protection of academic freedom and human rights said in a statement on Friday. “This violent dispersal and ensuing arrests are direct assaults on the constitutional right to peaceful assembly,” it stressed.
